summary: This document defines HTTP fields for integrity digests. Content-Digest protects message content and Repr-Digest protects a representation. Want-Content-Digest and Want-Repr-Digest let a sender state its preferences. It obsoletes RFC 3230 and the Digest and Want-Digest fields.

eli5.summary: When you send a package, you can add a sealed number that sums up what is inside. The receiver recomputes it to check nothing got changed or lost.
